assays.assay_description: Mice with a magnetic ear tag placed in a 4"x4"x4" clear plastic open-top container surrounded by a copper coil; head movements detected via electromagnetic induction for 120 min immediately after i.p. injection. Measures: total HTR count and duration (FWHM of HTR rate time course).

application_type.evidence: recorded for 120 min immediately after intraperitoneal injection of drug or vehicle.

time_to_assay.evidence: we recorded for 120 min immediately after intraperitoneal injection of drug or vehicle.

sample_size.evidence: n = 34 mice (3 males and 3 females for each condition, except 3 males and 1 female for saline condition).

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT produced a dose-dependent increase in total head-twitch count (significant at 40 mg/kg vs saline). The duration of HTR for 5-MeO-DMT was consistently brief (~3-5 min) regardless of dose, and significantly shorter than the ~14 min duration produced by 1 mg/kg psilocybin.
outcomes.statistics: 5 mg/kg: P=0.2, 10 mg/kg: P=0.2, 20 mg/kg: P=0.06, 40 mg/kg: P=0.02 (one-way ANOVA vs saline). Duration: P=0.5 across 5-MeO-DMT doses; 5-MeO-DMT vs psilocybin duration P=0.001 (treatment effect), post hoc P=0.002-0.03.
outcomes.evidence: Escalating doses of 5-MeO-DMT up to the highest doses tested led to more head-twitch responses ... duration of 5-MeO-DMT's effects was consistently brief regardless of the dose tested ... relative to that of psilocybin (14 ± 3 min).

assays.assay_description: Male-female pair placed in a cylindrical chamber (6" diameter x 7" height) within a soundproof box; male injected and recorded for 200 s after female introduction. USVs detected and classified into 11 subtypes using VocalMat (CNN-based classifier).

application_type.evidence: psilocybin, 1 mg/kg, i.p.; 5-MeO-DMT, 20 mg/kg, i.p.; ketamine, 10 mg/kg, i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: Socialization occurred from the time of weaning until 50 days after birth and involved putting a male-female pair of juvenile mice into a cylindrical recording chamber ... Socialization took place 3 times a week, for 3 consecutive weeks.

setup_restrain.evidence: Male-female pair allowed to interact freely in the chamber.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described as present in the 200-s recording chamber.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described as present in the 200-s recording chamber.

time_to_assay.evidence: male mice were injected ... and then placed into the recording chamber for 5 min before a female was added and the interaction recorded for 200 s.

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT (20 mg/kg) nearly completely suppressed social USVs (-99.9%), a stronger effect than psilocybin (-30%) and ketamine (-62%). Drugs also altered the distribution of USV subtypes, favoring short USVs over step sounds for psilocybin and ketamine.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocybin: -30 ± 6%, P=2x10^-4; 5-MeO-DMT: -99.90 ± 0.03%, P=6x10^-5; Ketamine: -62 ± 8%, P=6x10^-5 (Wilcoxon signed-rank). Subtype distributions: psilocybin χ²=408.5, P<10^-5; 5-MeO-DMT χ²=55.3, P<10^-5; ketamine χ²=1543.4, P<10^-5.
outcomes.evidence: The 5-MeO-DMT-treated mice had an even greater decrease in social USVs (-99.90 ± 0.03%; P = 6×10^-5).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of vocalizations plus proportions of 11 distinct USV subtypes (chevron, step up, up FM, step down, two steps, short, flat, reverse chevron, multiple steps, complex, down FM).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total counts and proportions over the 200 s window; no within-session time course reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of vocalization sequences, transitions, or bout structure.

B4_ethological.evidence: Social ultrasonic vocalizations produced during mating behavior are a natural communication behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: male-female pair ... allowing them to interact ... interaction recorded for 200 s.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate mating-context vocalization; no learning/memory required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: vocalizations detected and classified into subtypes using automated routines based on machine learning algorithms using the VocalMat software ... pre-trained convolutional neural network.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only chi-square tests on subtype proportions; no PCA/UMAP or dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: cylindrical recording chamber (6" diameter x 7" height, acrylic exterior with rubber dampening mat).

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge described in chamber.

E3_bedding.evidence: Rubber dampening mat described; no bedding mentioned.

E7_social_context.evidence: male-female pair ... allowing them to interact.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water described in chamber during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: On the first 3 days, male mice were injected with saline ... On the fourth day, a drug was injected prior to the same recording procedure ... three iterations of a 4-day vocalization protocol.

D3_recording_days.evidence: three iterations of a 4-day vocalization protocol = 12 recording days per mouse (3 baseline + 1 drug per iteration x 3 iterations).

D4_baseline.evidence: On the first 3 days, male mice were injected with saline ... to determine baseline number of vocalizations.

D5_followup.evidence: No post-acute (>=24 h after drug) USV recording reported; subsequent baseline days are after a new saline injection.

judge_notes: Two assays identified: head-twitch response and social USV. Imaging of dendritic spines (longitudinal two-photon microscopy) was excluded per rubric (histological/anatomical endpoint, not a behavioural assay).
B1 for USV set to 2 (4-6 measures) because the study reports total USV count plus proportions across 11 subtypes, which exceeds 3 distinct measures (qwen scored 2; glm/gptoss scored lower).

D3 for USV adjusted to 8-14 (score 2): three iterations of a 4-day protocol = 12 recording days per animal where baseline USV data are explicitly collected and reported; all candidates underestimated this.
B1 for HTR kept at 1 (2-3 measures: total count + duration); candidate qwen and gptoss agreed.
D2 for HTR set to 2 (61 min-6 h): 120 min recording is >60 min per rubric boundary; glm's score of 1 was an error.
B7 for HTR scored 0: peak detection on a magnetic coil voltage signal is signal processing, not a video/pose ML behavioural classifier.
Setup habituation for USV scored 'yes' (extensive pre-test socialization in the same chamber 3x/week for 3 weeks).
